title: pakistan-macro-data: a reproducible, documented repository of Pakistani macroeconomic time series
description: CPI, CPI inflation, exchange rate (bilateral, nominal effective, real effective), industrial production, reserves, broad money, and a policy-rate proxy for Pakistan -- monthly where available (World Bank Global Economic Monitor, 1987-present) and annual otherwise (World Bank WDI), each with full source/frequency/unit/transformation metadata, stationarity diagnostics, and cross-source validation.
